rows.title: Etsy Marketplace Insights as First-Party Demand Oracle
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Once the Etsy shop exists, use Etsy Marketplace Insights as a primary research input where accessible: real Etsy search terms, recent search volume, related terms/trends and listing competition. Use limited free research capacity efficiently; if a paid Etsy tier would materially improve research, present exact cost and expected value for owner approval.

rows.title: Search-Arbitrage and Competitive-Weakness Scoring
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Score each micro-market using demand, competition/listing density, quality of current offers, pricing/AOV, season timing, Brambleloop differentiation, machine verifiability, support burden and expected contribution. Explicitly hunt meaningful demand where competitors have weak thumbnails, poor PDFs, no video, confusing instructions, weak branding/bundles, stale aesthetics, limited sizes or recurring complaints.

rows.title: Product Selection Tournament
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Do not fully engineer the first ideas. Generate roughly 75-100 inexpensive concepts -> research about 40 -> develop stronger commercial/visual propositions for about 20 -> prototype/digital-twin about 10-15 -> fully release only the strongest 5-10. Every stage has a kill gate. Concentrate engineering cost only after commercial evidence improves.

rows.title: Pre-Production Demand Validation
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Where platform rules permit, test truthful concepts/aesthetics on Pinterest, social and owned channels before expensive engineering. Clearly identify concepts and do not imply an unavailable item is a finished purchasable product. Never use fake Etsy listings, fake purchases or fabricated engagement.

rows.title: Fast Lane and Flagship Lane
rows.criterion_quote: Operate two production queues after core QA stabilizes.
rows.basis: criterion text requires production deployment / soak
rows.criterion: Operate two production queues after core QA stabilizes. FAST LANE: lower-complexity Class A/B products such as ornaments, coasters, mug rugs, selected hats, simple decor and suitable simple amigurumi for rapid learning/search coverage. FLAGSHIP LANE: premium blankets, major collections, selected garments and sophisticated seasonal products for authority, content depth and AOV. Both retain all applicable quality gates.

rows.title: Proof Stack
rows.criterion_quote: Every flagship should accumulate progressively stronger proof: deterministic validation -> independent reverse compilation -> physical tester examples -> real customer projects/reviews -> repeat purchases.
rows.basis: criterion text demands live operations
rows.criterion: Every flagship should accumulate progressively stronger proof: deterministic validation -> independent reverse compilation -> physical tester examples -> real customer projects/reviews -> repeat purchases. Marketing must distinguish proof levels honestly. Use tester/customer photos only with appropriate permission.

rows.title: Creator and Tester Distribution
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Build a legitimate creator/tester seeding database with specialty, audience fit, reliability, engagement and permissions. Use it for independent physical proof, finished photos, colour variations, crochet-alongs, disclosed affiliate partnerships and real audience exposure. Never require or purchase dishonest reviews.

rows.title: Free-to-Paid Acquisition Engine

rows.basis: criterion text demands live operations
rows.criterion: Build owned SEO/Pinterest funnels around useful free motifs, mini patterns, tutorials and tools that demonstrate Brambleloop quality and lead naturally to premium singles/collections. Track visitor -> consented email -> first purchase -> repeat purchase -> collection purchase. Free content must have a commercial job.

rows.title: Listing Experiment Discipline
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text

rows.title: Customer-Service Conversion Advantage

rows.basis: criterion text demands live operations

rows.title: Promotional Science
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Use genuine time-bounded sales/coupons/order minimums only when policy-compliant. Measure incremental conversion, AOV and contribution, not merely revenue lift. Avoid conditioning the catalogue to require permanent discounts.

rows.title: Owned-Audience Compounding
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Every flagship should have an owned acquisition counterpart: SEO article/tutorial, Pinterest cluster, video where useful and consented email path. Track assisted conversions. Reduce long-term dependence on Etsy for every visit.

rows.title: Creator Micro-Seeding
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Start with small legitimate collaborations and disclosed affiliate arrangements where appropriate. Measure attributable traffic, conversion, usable proof assets and support impact before scaling creator spend.

rows.title: Numeric Scale/Kill Framework
rows.criterion_quote: Learn baselines for CTR, conversion, contribution per visitor, refund/support rate and paid CAC.
rows.basis: criterion text demands live operations
rows.criterion: Learn baselines for CTR, conversion, contribution per visitor, refund/support rate and paid CAC. Weak CTR -> thumbnail/title intervention. Strong CTR/weak conversion -> offer/trust/price. Strong conversion/low traffic -> distribution investment. High sales/high support -> QA before scaling. Learn thresholds from real data.

rows.title: Revenue and Contribution per Visitor

rows.basis: criterion text demands live operations
rows.criterion: Make Revenue per Visitor and Contribution per Visitor first-class metrics. A higher-priced product with slightly lower conversion may be commercially superior to a cheap product. Pricing, SEO and paid-media agents optimize contribution economics rather than conversion rate alone.

Every weekly review identifies the largest constraint: traffic, CTR, conversion, AOV, repeat rate, product coverage or margin.

rows.title: Conditional Scale Rules

rows.basis: C pattern matched but reviewed as not live-only: a diagnostic rule (high traffic + weak CTR -> thumbnail/title), testable with fixtures

rows.criterion: Track agent/API minutes and dollar cost per concept, validated pattern, PDF, listing, video asset, support case and acquired customer. rows.title: Stagnation / Thrash Detection
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Any agent that observes three materially identical states without progress must stop polling and re-plan. Repeated identical tool call + identical result triggers a circuit breaker. Polling backs off exponentially. Deployment retries require a changed hypothesis/root-cause fix. Track progress-per-dollar and progress-per-iteration; suspend loops consuming budget without state change.

rows.title: Etsy Creativity / AI Disclosure Gate
rows.blocked_by: external: Etsy pages 403 to automation / no API
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Before every Etsy release, classify the product under current Etsy Creativity Standards and generate required disclosures. Etsy permits seller-designed digital downloads and seller-prompted AI creations, but AI use must be disclosed where required. Policy Agent must re-fetch current policy before enabling new asset/product classes. Never assume an AI-generated lifestyle image satisfies Etsy's listing-image requirements.

rows.title: Evidence-Backed Listing Imagery Policy
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Separate product proof from promotional concept imagery. For patterns, prioritize real tester/customer finished-project photography as soon as available. Store provenance, consent/license, pattern version, yarn/colour and whether image is physical, simulated or AI-assisted. If current Etsy policy requires seller-owned photos/video or restricts renderings for the relevant listing class, the Policy Gate blocks incompatible assets.

rows.title: Marketplace Insights Query Budgeter
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Marketplace Insights becomes a scarce first-party research resource. Allocate keyword queries using expected information gain: validate the highest-uncertainty/highest-value micro-markets first. Store every query/result snapshot so the same keyword is not wastefully re-queried. Etsy Plus/unlimited access is an owner-approved upgrade only when expected value exceeds cost.

rows.title: Trend Data Provenance and Geography
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Every trend/search datum stores source, date range, geography/population and freshness. Etsy trend reports can be based on specific populations/time windows, so agents may not present U.S.-only or historical trend data as current Canadian/global demand. Opportunity scores discount stale or mismatched evidence.

rows.title: Policy Freshness Watch
rows.blocked_by: external: Etsy pages 403 to automation / no API
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Policy Agent performs scheduled checks of Etsy Seller Policy, Creativity Standards, listing-image rules, advertising rules and shilling/review rules. Material policy changes create a blocking incident for affected workflows until reviewed/tested. Store policy version/date with each release certificate.

rows.title: Product Rights / Commercial-Use Terms
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Each Brambleloop pattern must carry explicit customer-use terms chosen deliberately: what the buyer may do with the PDF, whether finished physical items may be sold, redistribution prohibition, and support/version policy. The terms must be consistent across PDF, listing and FAQ and should be legally reviewed before relying on them as enforceable.

rows.title: Refund / Chargeback / Case Prevention
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Design digital-product messaging to prevent mistaken purchases: prominent 'DIGITAL CROCHET PATTERN — NOT A FINISHED ITEM', skill level, required materials, terminology and download/support instructions. Track confusion-driven contacts/refunds as a conversion-quality defect. Customer Experience prioritizes resolution before Etsy's case window where applicable.

rows.title: Tester Capacity Marketplace
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Treat physical testing as a schedulable constrained resource. Forecast upcoming Class B/C testing demand, maintain tester reliability/specialty scores, avoid one tester becoming a bottleneck, and schedule seasonal products early enough that physical QA does not miss the making window.

rows.title: Product Cannibalization / Bundle Attribution
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: When adding adjacent products and bundles, measure whether they create incremental revenue or merely move buyers from a higher-contribution SKU. Attribute bundle uplift, attach rate and cannibalization before declaring Winner Amplification successful.

rows.title: Price Elasticity Memory
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Pricing experiments build a category-specific elasticity history. Record price, sale state, traffic source, season, conversion, AOV and contribution. Avoid interpreting seasonal traffic changes as price effects. Use genuine regular prices and truthful temporary promotions.

rows.title: Launch Cohort Holdout
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Where practical, maintain small organic/control cohorts before scaling paid promotion so the system can distinguish genuine listing/product improvement from traffic purchased by ads. Record assisted versus direct outcomes.

rows.title: Pre-Etsy Launch Readiness Gate
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Before asking owner to open/connect live Etsy operations, require: brand/name clearance checkpoint; storefront asset pack; at least several release-ready products with truthful proof status; policies/FAQ; digital-item disclosure language; customer-support knowledge; pricing/promotion plan; launch calendar; analytics baseline; exact owner setup checklist; and rollback plan.

rows.title: Dimensional Consistency Auditor
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Every displayed measurement must trace to one canonical measurement object. Detect contradictory or contextless dimensions such as a finished-size card showing 90×122 cm alongside an unexplained 180 cm marker. Labels must identify width, length, circumference, component, blocked state and size variant where relevant.

rows.title: Visual Semantic QA
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: The system must test whether an image communicates what its caption/title claims. A finished-result frame cannot be only abstract horizontal rows. A chart preview must look like a chart preview. A size card must communicate scale clearly. Use independent visual review plus deterministic metadata assertions; do not rely on the generator grading itself.

rows.title: Evidence-to-Creative Pipeline
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Required flow: CIR -> compiled/twin truth -> engineering evidence -> creative brief constrained by truth -> conversion creative -> independent Asset Truth comparison -> layout/commercial/policy gates -> listing export. Creative systems may improve presentation but may never invent motifs, dimensions, texture, construction or included deliverables.

rows.title: Physical Proof Upgrade Path
rows.criterion_quote: Replace or supplement weaker conceptual assets with genuine finished-project proof where rights permit, then measure CTR/conversion impact.
rows.basis: criterion text demands live operations
rows.criterion: For products initially marketed with permitted non-physical representations, create an automatic upgrade task when tester/customer physical photography becomes available. Replace or supplement weaker conceptual assets with genuine finished-project proof where rights permit, then measure CTR/conversion impact.

rows.title: Mobile-First Creative QA
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Evaluate every listing set as a shopper actually sees it: search thumbnail, phone gallery, first 3 frames, then full gallery. Store screenshots/renders of these contexts during QA. Optimize title-safe area and visual hierarchy for small screens rather than desktop-only output.

rows.title: Competitive Creative Benchmark
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Before release, compare the listing set against a current sample of strong products in the same micro-market on measurable dimensions: finished-result clarity, thumbnail stop-power, proof, information density, consistency, video/support proposition and visual polish. Do not copy competitor creative; use the benchmark to reject obviously substandard presentation.

If quick low-sew minis outperform late in a season, future seasonal allocation learns that timing rule. Transfer mechanisms, not designs.

rows.title: Four-Season Engine

rows.title: Non-Holiday Occasion Engine

rows.criterion: Continuously explore birthdays, baby showers, nursery, weddings, housewarming, teacher gifts, graduation, pet gifts, hostess gifts and family keepsakes. These provide evergreen/event demand that complements the holiday calendar.

A concept that would have passed six months ago can fail today if the company has learned enough to demand better. Continuous improvement must literally raise the release bar.

rows.title: Instruction Clarity Benchmark
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Score scanability, repeat notation, row grouping, stitch-count visibility, terminology consistency, size grading, colour-change clarity, assembly clarity and cognitive load. Identify mechanisms that make instructions easier or harder to follow. Convert winning mechanisms into Brambleloop publishing requirements.

rows.title: Chart and Diagram Benchmark

rows.title: Beginner Experience Benchmark

rows.criterion: Audit assumptions about prior knowledge, technique links, photo/video support, error recovery, terminology variants, tips, progress checkpoints and confidence-building. rows.title: Premium Experience Benchmark

Brambleloop's Premium Product Standard should be benchmarked against the best purchased experience, not the average.

rows.criterion: Where purchased products include video/tutorial support, record structure, chaptering, technique coverage, pacing, correspondence to pattern sections, accessibility and whether video materially reduces ambiguity. rows.title: Digital Delivery Packaging Audit
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Record number of files, filenames, versions, print versus screen editions, charts, bonus files, language variants, file sizes and organization. Design Brambleloop's delivery bundle to be easier to understand immediately after purchase.

rows.title: Support and Rights Experience Audit

Preserve raw notes and confidence.

rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Do not copy one seller wholesale. Construct Brambleloop Premium Product Standard from the strongest mechanisms observed across the entire library: best chart practice from one benchmark, strongest navigation from another, best beginner support from another, etc., combined with Brambleloop's own engineering, version-aware support and brand system.

rows.title: Brambleloop Must Add Unique Value

Brambleloop should engineer positive surprise without bloating products with useless filler.

rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Every material task, defect, opportunity, benchmark, listing, experiment, customer issue and improvement must have an accountable agent/cell and an explicit state. The orchestrator detects orphaned work and reassigns it. 'Everyone has a job' is enforced through ownership records, not assumed.

rows.criterion: Create dedicated meta-agents whose sole job is to improve other agents and departments. Their work is measured by verified uplift, not number of changes.

Replay representative historical tasks plus fresh holdouts, compare quality/cost/latency/reliability, and promote only statistically/operationally meaningful improvements. rows.criterion: More agents are allowed, but redundant or consistently weak agents are merged, retrained or retired. Preserve useful specialist knowledge before retirement. This prevents organizational bloat while keeping the owner's 'never too many specialists' principle focused on actual performance.

rows.title: Weekly Deep Evolution Cycle
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Run a deeper weekly audit across product creativity, pattern correctness, competitor intelligence, conversion, ads, support, infrastructure and cost. Re-evaluate department architecture itself: add specialist agents where gaps exist, merge redundant ones, revise metrics, and update the improvement roadmap.

rows.title: Proof of Off-Device Autonomy
rows.basis: board root cause release_not_deployed: the row's evidence is a production readback of a release not yet deployed
rows.criterion: Before launch, prove the owner can turn off all personal computers for at least 24 hours while cloud Brambleloop continues scheduled cycles, queue processing, monitoring, learning tasks and state persistence. Record timestamps, jobs completed, incidents, costs and restart/recovery evidence. This is a launch-blocking acceptance test.

rows.title: Model Anti-Drift Release Gate
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Every model-led asset must pass identity-consistency checks against the canonical reference pack. A beautiful image of the wrong woman fails. Detect gradual face drift, hair/eye drift, age drift and stylization drift across batches and over time. Failed assets regenerate before release.

rows.title: Appropriate Product-First Styling
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: The canonical model is attractive and premium but appropriately dressed for the product, season and Etsy shopping context. Garments must remain the commercial subject. Styling should resemble high-end crochet/lifestyle editorial photography, not glamour imagery that distracts from fit, texture, construction or product details.

rows.title: Model Merchandising Shot System
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: For model-appropriate products, generate a coherent shot plan: primary product-first hero, full/three-quarter fit, front/back/side as relevant, texture/detail, sleeve/neckline/closure/construction detail, scale/context and optional lifestyle shot. The model must increase trust, aspiration and brand recognition while preserving truthful product representation.

rows.title: Mandatory MJsOffTheHookDesigns Source
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Canonical benchmark URL: https://www.etsy.com/ca/shop/MJsOffTheHookDesigns . Store this literal reference in configuration and documentation. Validate URL health and resolution; if Etsy changes routing, resolve the shop's current canonical location without silently substituting a different seller.

rows.title: Listing-by-Listing Deep Audit
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Every discoverable benchmark listing selected for baseline/deep audit is individually opened. Capture and analyze all accessible listing gallery assets, video where accessible, title, visible description, price/sale presentation, options/variants, badges, product claims, digital-delivery positioning, cross-sell cues and other commercially relevant listing structure. Do not claim an audit occurred if only search-result thumbnails were seen.

rows.title: Vision-Level Gallery Analysis
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Browser agents must inspect the actual gallery, not merely scrape text. For every accessible image, derive non-copying commercial observations: shot type, composition, product visibility, model/product relationship, setting, scale communication, detail coverage, infographic use, typography, palette role, thumbnail readability and emotional merchandising. Preserve dated evidence/provenance.

rows.title: Central Competitive Intelligence Director
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: A central director coordinates specialist pods, deduplicates observations, identifies cross-category mechanisms, routes new benchmark releases to the correct cells, and prevents siloed learning. It maintains a company-level view of where Brambleloop is ahead, at parity or materially behind on concrete dimensions without using that as permission to copy protected expression.

rows.title: Adaptive Monitoring Cadence
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Monitoring frequency adapts to observed posting/change behaviour, seasonal urgency and evidence freshness. During active release periods or major seasonal ramps, checks may be frequent; during quiet periods they back off. The objective is near-immediate discovery of commercially meaningful changes without pointless compute burn.

rows.title: New-Listing Event Pipeline
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: A new MJs listing becomes a structured market event. Archive dated observations, classify category, notify relevant specialist pods, decompose the commercial mechanisms, update category benchmark standards, run opportunity analysis and decide whether it justifies an original Brambleloop concept tournament.

rows.title: Same-Arena Response Lane
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Brambleloop is allowed to enter the same broad/generic product arena when market evidence supports it - e.g., cardigan, stocking, blanket, hat, ornament or coaster. Agents should identify what makes the benchmark compelling and design a substantively original Brambleloop alternative with stronger product engineering, styling, usability, fit, construction, creativity or customer experience. Do not restrict Brambleloop merely because an elite competitor also sells that generic product type.

rows.title: Breakthrough Response Lane
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: In parallel, benchmark releases should trigger a more divergent tournament asking what the competitor has NOT made: adjacent functions, new recipients, transformations, silhouettes, construction systems, bundles, seasonal stories and collection families. Maintain both incremental market participation and breakthrough exploration.

rows.title: Benchmark Mechanism Decomposition
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Store reusable lessons only at the mechanism level: silhouette strength, fit strategy, styling, colour architecture, photography coverage, product family logic, beginner support, seasonal timing, thumbnail clarity, merchandising, bundle logic and customer promise. Do not turn competitor protected pattern text/images into Brambleloop source designs.

rows.title: MJs Challenge Gate
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: For relevant categories, place Brambleloop candidates beside current category-matched MJs benchmark evidence in a blinded comparison. Evaluate concept desirability, distinctiveness, product clarity, thumbnail strength, styling, apparent craftsmanship, giftability and purchase confidence. If Brambleloop looks obviously generic/amateur by comparison, return it to creative development rather than shipping.

rows.title: Elite Panel Beyond One Seller
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: MJs is the anchor, not the only teacher. Maintain a changing elite panel including other category leaders and purchased Benchmark Library products. A category specialist should learn from the best available examples across sellers so Brambleloop can combine best-of-breed mechanisms and avoid overfitting to one shop's aesthetic.

rows.title: Benchmark Quality Bar Moves
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: When MJs or another elite benchmark materially improves presentation, product format or customer experience, relevant Brambleloop standards are re-evaluated. The competitive bar is dynamic. Improvement Department records which standards changed and why.

rows.title: Mandatory Cloud Browser + Vision Capability
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: The MJs/elite benchmark observation layer requires production-capable browser traversal plus image/gallery understanding that operates in cloud infrastructure with owner devices off. Build 2 must not silently replace this with static seeded data, occasional manual screenshots or text-only search. Missing capability is an explicit owner/integration gate.

rows.title: Browser/Vision Acceptance Test
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Prove end-to-end capability against the canonical benchmark: resolve shop URL; enumerate catalogue; open multiple listings; traverse gallery assets; capture visible listing text/commerce metadata; produce image-level observations; classify into specialist pods; persist evidence; detect a simulated/new change; and trigger a re-audit. Evidence must show each step actually occurred.

rows.title: Competitor Evidence Cache
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Cache content fingerprints and analysis so unchanged listings are not repeatedly paid for in model/browser compute. New images, changed descriptions, pricing/sale shifts, new video or new listing identity invalidate only the necessary analysis nodes and propagate lessons through the dependency graph.

rows.title: Specialist Pod Continuous Learning
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Every MJs/category pod participates in the continuous-learning architecture from #177-194: maintain category mistakes, new mechanisms, successful Brambleloop responses, failed responses, current benchmarks and challenger strategies. The pod should become measurably more discerning and creative over time.

rows.title: Competitive Learning Is Input, Not Creative Ceiling
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: No agent may treat 'match MJs' as the final creative objective. The benchmark establishes a commercial quality floor and a source of market evidence. Brambleloop's Creative Department must still search for original white space, new product forms and stronger customer value beyond what the benchmark currently offers.

rows.title: Owner Quality Veto
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Until automated creative evaluation has demonstrated reliable alignment with the owner's standards, the owner retains veto over canonical model identity and flagship creative quality. Repeated veto reasons become structured training/evaluation evidence for the Improvement Department rather than disappearing as chat feedback. rows.title: Pinterest Search Factory

rows.criterion: Create an autonomous Pinterest production system around each validated product/collection: multiple genuinely distinct pins, keyword/board mapping, seasonal lead-time scheduling, landing destination, creative testing and attribution. rows.title: Google / SEO Topic Cluster Engine
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Build owned search clusters around buyer/maker questions connected to Brambleloop categories. Each cluster maps informational intent -> useful free content/tool -> relevant paid product/collection. Measure organic qualified visits, assisted conversion, email capture where permitted and revenue contribution.

rows.title: Video Distribution Flywheel
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Flagships and technique-heavy products generate reusable video modules: product reveal, technique explanation, progress checkpoints, troubleshooting and finished-result clips. Repurpose appropriately across YouTube/Shorts/Pinterest/social while keeping a canonical tutorial. Track assisted conversion and support reduction.

rows.title: Tester-to-Ambassador Path
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: High-performing physical testers may graduate into ambassadors/creators when appropriate and consensual. Their real finished projects can provide trustworthy proof, colourways and educational content. Separate testing compensation/feedback from public review incentives.

rows.title: Email / Owned Audience Lifecycle
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Where Brambleloop lawfully collects consented email subscribers, operate lifecycle flows: welcome/value, category interest, launch, post-purchase support, cross-sell and seasonal reactivation. Segment by demonstrated interest and frequency-cap communications. Track incremental contribution, not open rate vanity.

rows.title: Repeat Purchase Engine
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Measure 30/60/90/180-day repeat rate by first product/category/season. Recommend relevant next projects, matching collections and future-season products. Customer lifetime contribution becomes a first-class growth metric.

rows.title: Collection Subscription / Club Research Lane
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Research whether a recurring pattern club, seasonal collection pass or membership would create genuine customer value and predictable revenue. Do not launch by assumption. Validate demand, support burden, delivery cadence and platform/channel feasibility first.

rows.title: Personalization / Customization Layer
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Where technically feasible and commercially valuable, explore controlled customization: colour planners, size selection, initials/names, motif arrangements or printable project variants. Keep canonical pattern truth intact and price/value-test personalization rather than giving away expensive complexity.

rows.title: Free Tool Acquisition Layer
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Build useful free utilities that attract high-intent makers: yarn/yardage helpers, colour planners, size calculators, project-time estimators, seasonal make-time planners or motif preview tools. Each tool must have a useful standalone purpose and a measured path to relevant Brambleloop products.

rows.title: Product-Led Referral Research
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Test legitimate referral/share mechanics that encourage customers to show finished projects or share useful products without manipulating reviews. Track attributable new customers and contribution. Never condition support or discounts on positive reviews.

rows.criterion: Project Tips from Failure Modes - Testing and support failures become concise project tips at the exact points customers are likely to struggle: tension, markers, joins, symmetry, stitch counts, sizing, seaming and finishing.

rows.title: Tutorial Linkage
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Tutorial Linkage - When a video/tutorial exists, the PDF and listing identify exactly which size/version it demonstrates. Video support supplements the written pattern; it does not become the only source of required instructions.

rows.title: Visual Gallery as Validation
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Visual Gallery as Validation - Finished-object gallery/reference imagery is useful as independent evidence that instructions produce plausible finished results, but it does not override written Product Truth or replace physical testing.

rows.title: Free-to-Paid Content Ladder
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Free-to-Paid Content Ladder - Where strategically appropriate, Brambleloop may use a free searchable article/tutorial as discovery and sell a cleaner premium PDF/package. The free and paid experiences must be intentionally differentiated rather than accidental duplicates.

rows.title: Multi-Channel Product Distribution
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Multi-Channel Product Distribution - A pattern can be distributed through multiple appropriate storefronts/content channels from one canonical product record. Pricing, version, files, description claims and update state stay synchronized.

rows.title: Video as Acquisition + Support
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Video as Acquisition + Support - Tutorial video is both customer support and discovery content. Agents track which patterns justify video based on demand, complexity, search opportunity, conversion and support reduction.

rows.title: Cross-Sell Graph
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Cross-Sell Graph - Every product records legitimate related products, bundles, collections, tutorials, materials and next-project recommendations. Agents optimize attach rate without misleading customers.

rows.title: Review-to-Product Learning
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Review-to-Product Learning - Reviews and support signals are mined for clarity, fit, errors, difficulty, missing explanation and desired variants. Agents convert recurring evidence into bounded product improvements and regression tests.

rows.title: Full Competitor Reverse-Engineering Allowed for Private R&D;
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Full Competitor Reverse-Engineering Allowed for Private R&D; - Agents may ingest the complete purchased pattern, reconstruct its functional garment architecture, stitch logic, grading, dimensions, workflow, customer experience, merchandising system and weaknesses inside the private benchmark environment.

rows.title: Functional Technique Reuse
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Functional Technique Reuse - Standard crochet methods, stitch names, general construction techniques, gauge concepts, sizing practices and other functional methods may be used when appropriate. Brambleloop should combine them into its own independently designed product rather than preserve a competitor's distinctive overall expression by default.

rows.title: Competitor Weakness Mining
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Competitor Weakness Mining - Agents should explicitly identify opportunities to outperform benchmark products: clearer instructions, better grading, more sizes, easier construction, better fit, stronger schematics, better tutorials, more useful yarn substitution, better accessibility, superior imagery, improved support and fewer customer failure points.

rows.title: Structured Curriculum
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Structured Curriculum - Maintain an original beginner-to-advanced curriculum rather than disconnected posts. Core tracks should cover foundations, tools/yarn, tension, core stitches, pattern reading, gauge/fit, finishing, garment construction, troubleshooting and advanced stitch systems as evidence and demand justify.

rows.title: Support-to-Lesson Trigger
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Support-to-Lesson Trigger - Cluster customer questions, refunds, support tickets, failed validations and review complaints. Repeated confusion automatically proposes a tutorial/FAQ/diagram/video/pattern clarification experiment.

rows.title: Search-to-Lesson Trigger
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Search-to-Lesson Trigger - SEO/Search agents identify high-intent educational queries and compare them against the Learn knowledge graph. Missing high-value topics become prioritized content opportunities.

rows.title: One Truth, Many Formats
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: One Truth, Many Formats - Each approved lesson has one canonical factual/teaching specification that can produce an article, concise FAQ, printable guide, diagram set, short video script, long video script, email, social carousel, short-form clips and pattern-specific help without factual drift.

rows.title: Difficulty Ladder
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Difficulty Ladder - Lessons and linked patterns carry evidence-backed prerequisite relationships. The system can recommend 'learn these two skills first' rather than relying only on vague beginner/intermediate labels.

rows.title: Contextual Help Inside Patterns
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Contextual Help Inside Patterns - Pattern PDFs/apps/listings can link directly to Brambleloop-owned lessons for stitches, gauge, seaming, blocking and other techniques. Help appears where the maker needs it without bloating every pattern.

rows.title: Gauge Learning System
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Gauge Learning System - Gauge receives a dedicated educational system: stitch vs row gauge, swatching, hook adjustment, yarn substitution, tension consistency, blocking and garment-fit consequences. Visual examples and calculators must agree with Product Truth.

rows.title: Free Lead Magnets
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Free Lead Magnets - Agents may build original high-value downloadable guides/checklists/calculators to earn email subscribers. Every lead magnet has a measurable acquisition goal, provenance, version and downstream attribution.

rows.title: Free-to-Paid Ladder
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Free-to-Paid Ladder - Educational/free content may lead naturally to premium Brambleloop patterns, bundles or tools when relevant. The free content must remain genuinely useful and must not become deceptive teaser content.

rows.title: Video Coverage Strategy
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Video Coverage Strategy - Track which lessons/patterns have video support, search demand, support burden and expected ROI. Create long-form tutorials only when evidence justifies them; derive Shorts/Reels/TikToks/Pins from canonical assets where useful.

rows.title: Pattern Video Contract
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Pattern Video Contract - When a video supports only a specific size/version, state that explicitly. The written pattern remains complete enough to stand on its own unless the product explicitly promises otherwise.

rows.title: Content Constellation
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Content Constellation - A product launch can automatically generate a constellation: listing, hero/detail imagery, stitch lesson, gauge help, construction article, video plan, email, social derivatives, Pinterest assets, FAQs, internal links and support entries - but only where each asset has real value.

rows.title: Internal Linking Engine
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Internal Linking Engine - Automatically propose and test useful links among lessons, patterns and support pages. Links are based on reader intent and prerequisite/product relevance, not keyword stuffing.

rows.title: Education SEO
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Education SEO - Learn pages have independent search briefs, intent classification, title/meta/schema strategy, FAQ opportunities and update cadence. Search optimization may not distort crochet truth.

rows.title: Content Freshness
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Content Freshness - Agents monitor lessons for stale links, changed terminology, broken media, obsolete products, new evidence and support-driven gaps. Updates are versioned and regression-checked.

rows.title: Email Learning Funnel
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Email Learning Funnel - Track subscriber source, lead magnet, lesson engagement and downstream product conversion. Email sequences teach first and sell contextually; unsubscribes and fatigue constrain frequency.

rows.title: Community Feedback Loop
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Community Feedback Loop - Community/project-photo/support signals feed the learning ledger. Common successes/failures can improve tutorials, patterns and FAQs while respecting privacy and content rights.

rows.title: Beginner Failure Simulation
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Beginner Failure Simulation - For foundational lessons, adversarial QA checks likely beginner mistakes: wrong loop, wrong stitch count, skipped turning chain, excessive tension, wrong hook, twisted foundation, missed gauge, reversed RS/WS and similar errors.

rows.title: Accessibility
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Accessibility - Educational pages and downloadable guides use readable hierarchy, alt text, captions/transcripts where appropriate, sufficient contrast, mobile-friendly layouts and clear terminology.

rows.title: Content Economics
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Content Economics - Track creation cost, maintenance cost, search traffic, email acquisition, assisted conversions, support deflection and attributable sales. High-cost/low-value formats are redesigned or retired.

rows.title: Studio Learn Dashboard
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Studio Learn Dashboard - Show curriculum coverage, content gaps, drafts, QA state, traffic, rankings, email captures, video queue, assisted sales, support-deflection signals, update needs and experiments in BrambleloopStudio.

rows.title: Cross-Department Ownership
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Cross-Department Ownership - Research finds gaps; Pattern supplies technical truth; Visual supplies truthful instructional assets; Marketing/SEO packages discovery; CX supplies confusion signals; Finance measures economics; Learn coordinates the educational product.

rows.title: Continuous Teaching Improvement
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Continuous Teaching Improvement - Every lesson participates in OBSERVE -> HYPOTHESIS -> EXPERIMENT -> MEASURE -> VALIDATE -> PROMOTE/REJECT. Improve explanations, visuals, sequencing and formats while preserving the underlying technical truth.

rows.title: Education Compounds
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Education Compounds - A solved customer question becomes reusable company knowledge. The target is that each new product and each support interaction makes future products easier to discover, understand, make and support.

rows.title: Consumption Required
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Consumption Required - Producing a reading is insufficient when the requirement exists to influence a downstream decision/action; prove the consumer.

rows.title: Audit-Repair Loop
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Audit-Repair Loop - Freeze -> audit -> defect -> repair -> regression -> full suite -> independent re-audit. Reporting never substitutes for repair.

rows.title: Shadow Rehearsal
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Shadow Rehearsal - Before activation, exercise opportunity -> design -> pattern -> QA -> Visual -> listing -> pricing -> approval -> publish refusal/simulation -> order/support/accounting through real runtime paths.

rows.title: Claude/Chat Independence
rows.basis: board root cause release_not_deployed: the row's evidence is a production readback of a release not yet deployed
rows.criterion: Claude/Chat Independence - Launch certification proves persistent runtime execution does not depend on an active Claude/Codex/Fable/ChatGPT development conversation.

rows.title: Restart Recovery
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Restart Recovery - Restart isolated runtime components during queued/in-flight work and prove durable recovery, fencing/idempotence and no unauthorized duplicate effect.

rows.title: B+C Default
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: B+C Default - Visual V2 defaults to deterministic/procedural product rendering plus protected photoreal presentation unless later evidence disproves it.

rows.title: No Product Redraw by Default
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: No Product Redraw by Default - Do not ask generative AI to recreate structure Brambleloop already knows when that can change stitch count, gauge, cable pitch, silhouette or features.

rows.title: Authoritative Product Region
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Authoritative Product Region - Certified product geometry/pixels remain authoritative through presentation wherever technically feasible.

rows.title: Construction Fidelity
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Construction Fidelity - Deterministic rendering must encode commercially material stitch/fabric/construction truth, not merely a schematic symbol.

rows.title: Bounded Material Enhancement
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Bounded Material Enhancement - AI may enhance fibre/fuzz/micro-material only when macro geometry/stitch boundaries remain protected and revalidated.

rows.title: Blind Original Graduation
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Blind Original Graduation - Product-only Visual V2 graduates on a Brambleloop-original design with no finished-product visual reference.

rows.title: On-Model After Product Lock
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: On-Model After Product Lock - On-model graduation follows product-only lock and must preserve both exact product and exact canonical Brambleloop model.

rows.title: Visual Economics
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Visual Economics - Track yield, rejection reasons, latency, compute, spend and cost per certified listing set.

rows.title: Repository Is Shared Memory
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Repository Is Shared Memory - Critical state lives in Git/database/evidence artifacts, not conversation context.

rows.title: Durable Handoffs
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Durable Handoffs - Long AI-development tasks persist objective, branch/head, decisions, defects, tests, unfinished work and next actions.

rows.title: Context Is a Cache
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Context Is a Cache - Persist conclusions before context pressure and reread durable state after compaction/restart.

rows.title: Session-Limit Survival
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Session-Limit Survival - Checkpoint partial work, patch series and assignments before session limits can kill subagents.

rows.title: Bounded Parallelism
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Bounded Parallelism - Use disjoint ownership and one integrator; optimize for integrated tested work per resource window, not maximum agent count.

rows.title: Independent Model Review
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Independent Model Review - A second model may adversarially review evidence without becoming certification authority.

rows.title: Empirical Model Routing
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Empirical Model Routing - Route Claude/Opus, Fable, Codex/Astra and future models by demonstrated outcome, cost, latency, context and tool fit.

rows.title: Approval Friction Is Cost
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Approval Friction Is Cost - Measure excessive development approval prompts as throughput loss; prefer bounded autonomous sandboxes while keeping production/spend/credential gates.

rows.title: Browser/Vision Ruling
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Browser/Vision Ruling - Ambiguous acceptance wording receives a durable owner ruling without fabricating past evidence.

rows.title: Physical Evidence Specificity
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Physical Evidence Specificity - Request physical/tester evidence only for the exact unresolved property it can prove.

rows.title: Launch Packet
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Launch Packet - Owner receives candidate SHA, tests/audit, Visual status, listings/products, policy state, owner actions, spend limits, economics, rollback and activation steps.

rows.basis: criterion text requires production deployment / soak
rows.criterion: Cloud-Resident Always-On Runtime - Production workers, scheduler, queues, state, evidence, alerts and recovery run on durable hosted infrastructure 24/7. Owner PC/phone availability is irrelevant to execution.

rows.title: No Development-Chat Dependency
rows.criterion_quote: Development models may improve the system; they are not the production scheduler or memory.
rows.basis: criterion text requires production deployment / soak
rows.criterion: No Development-Chat Dependency - Normal company operation must not require an active Claude, Codex, Fable or ChatGPT session. Development models may improve the system; they are not the production scheduler or memory.

rows.title: Overnight Autonomy
rows.criterion_quote: Overnight Autonomy - The system deliberately uses unattended hours for safe work such as research, analysis, design candidates, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, experiments in authorized sandboxes and preparation of owner decisions.
rows.basis: criterion text requires production deployment / soak
rows.criterion: Overnight Autonomy - The system deliberately uses unattended hours for safe work such as research, analysis, design candidates, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, experiments in authorized sandboxes and preparation of owner decisions.

rows.title: Smart Notification Policy
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Smart Notification Policy - Notify the owner for decisions, risk, deadlines, meaningful commercial events and anomalies - not routine machine chatter. Alerts are deduplicated, severity-ranked and actionable.

rows.title: Bank/Etsy/Processor Reconciliation
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Bank/Etsy/Processor Reconciliation - When data access exists, reconcile marketplace orders, deposits, fees, refunds, taxes and bank/processor movements. Differences become exceptions requiring resolution, not silent adjustments.

rows.title: Cash & Runway Intelligence
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Cash & Runway Intelligence - Provide current cash obligations, upcoming bills/renewals, committed spend, expected payouts, tax reserves, safe discretionary budget and runway/coverage signals.

rows.title: Owner Availability SLO
rows.basis: board root cause release_not_deployed: the row's evidence is a production readback of a release not yet deployed
rows.criterion: Owner Availability SLO - The owner command center and core read-only company status target continuous availability independent of the owner's devices, with monitored uptime and a documented degraded mode.

rows.basis: board root cause release_not_deployed: the row's evidence is a production readback of a release not yet deployed
rows.criterion: Production Autonomy SLO - Define and monitor expected scheduler/worker cadence freshness, queue latency, recovery time and critical department heartbeat. Violations raise incidents.

rows.title: Store Preview Mode
rows.basis: no production or live-operations requirement in the criterion text
rows.criterion: Store Preview Mode - Provide an owner-facing customer-view preview of the complete shop/listing set before activation, including images, titles, descriptions, prices, files, disclosures and mobile presentation.
